label: Minimax_H3_Image
notes: workflow.json is the source of truth from here on (Harry continues from it). Source: the ComfyUI gallery template image_minimax_h3_image_t2i (free, local), fetched with comfy-mcp on 2026-11-14 and converted to API format by comfy-cli (`comfy run --print-prompt`), not by ComfyUI's own Save (API). Subgraph nodes are flattened to IDs like 23:1.

Claude's edits to the converted template, all retitles: Save Image (9) -> nuke_save; Text (user_prompt) (23:24) -> nuke_prompt; KSampler (23:7) -> nuke_ksampler; Generate Text (23:15) -> nuke_generate_text; If/Else Switch (23:22) -> nuke_enhance_switch; Load Diffusion Model (23:1) -> nuke_load_diffusion_model; Load CLIP 32B (23:2) -> nuke_load_text_encoder; MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning (23:5) -> nuke_conditioning.
Width and height are bound on nuke_conditioning, which replaces the links from the Resolution Selector (14), leaving it orphaned and unexecuted (same as the MiniMax video nodes).
Harry generated with it in the Nuke GUI on 2026-11-14, prompt enhancer on: the conversion and the retitles work end to end.

knobs.name: model
knobs.tooltip: Diffusion model file: the MiniMax H3 Image models installed in ComfyUI. Variants differ in precision (int8, bf16, w4a8 ...): higher precision is better quality but needs more VRAM and time.

knobs.name: text_encoder
knobs.label: text encoder
knobs.tooltip: The Qwen3-VL 32B model that reads the prompt. int8 is the template's choice; nvfp4 is smaller (the one the MiniMax video nodes use) and may cost some prompt accuracy.

knobs.name: enhance
knobs.label: enhance prompt
knobs.tooltip: Expand the prompt into a detailed caption with the Qwen 3.5 LLM before generating (the model reads detailed captions best). Slower; the expanded text appears in 'used prompt'.

knobs.name: steps
knobs.tooltip: Sampling steps. The model is distilled for 6.
